people.name: Topheth
people.line: Site of pagan child sacrifice, south of Jerusalem

translations.web: This is what I will do to this place,” says Yahweh, “and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth.
translations.bsb: This is what I will do to this place and to its residents, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.
translations.kjv: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
translations.asv: Thus will I do unto this place, saith Jehovah, and to the inhabitants thereof, even making this city as Topheth:
